sample_unit: amended patient cases per LLM (40 MIMIC-IV cases x race/ethnicity and sex combinations)

links.outcome: Change in LLM pain rating and opioid recommendations when patient race/ethnicity and sex were varied
links.effect: Race/ethnicity and sex did not influence pain ratings or opioid name, order, or dosage recommendations for GPT-4 or Gemini; the models differed from each other (Gemini more often rated pain severe, recommended strong opioids).
links.quote: Race/ethnicity and sex did not influence LLM recommendations.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of bias (equity/safety) in LLM-generated opioid management recommendations across demographic variations using clinical vignettes from MIMIC-IV.
